e: Russia agrees to provide compensation over its shooting down of Azerbaijan Airlines Flight 8243 in 2024 following negotiations with Azerbaijan.
A court in Baku sentences French businessman Martin Ryan to 10 years' imprisonment on charges of spying.
Foreign minister Tom Berendsen announces the temporary relocation of staff and operations of the Dutch embassy in Iran to Baku, Azerbaijan, citing security risks to personnel amid the Iranian war.
Azerbaijan reopens its border crossings with Iran to cargo traffic after closing them following the drone incident in Nakhchivan.
A suspected Iranian drone attack is carried out at Nakhchivan International Airport and Şəkərabad in Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, injuring two people.
A magnitude 4.8 earthquake hits Shamakhi District, destroying dozens of buildings.
An Azerbaijani court sentences Ruben Vardanyan, the former State Minister of the Republic of Artsakh, to 20 years' imprisonment.
President Aliyev publicly accuses Russia of carrying out deliberate attacks against Azerbaijani diplomatic outposts and energy infrastructure in Ukraine.
US vice president JD Vance visits Baku and oversees the signing of a strategic partnership agreement between the United States and Azerbaijan.
The State Security Service announces the arrest of three people accused of plotting an attack on an embassy in Baku on behalf of Islamic State – Khorasan Province.
